# Basic native document fixture

`vector-basic.pcraft` is a STORE ZIP with `manifest.json` only; `vector-basic.json` is its readable mirror. Original Local Image fixture, GPL-3.0-or-later. Generated by `crates/pc-format/examples/vector_arch_fixture.rs` (first on 2026-10-10; re-generated on 2026-10-14 in the current format version 3, when v2 stopped reading older formats — the document content is unchanged and the generator reproduces these bytes exactly). It contains a live rectangle with fill/stroke, a vector mask, point text, a saved path, a work path and a clipping path. The additive fields are empty and omitted: the JSON explicitly has no `vector`, `symbols` or `design_units` keys. No external blob, font or renderer is needed to load it. Both files are under 50 KB.

Tests load the checked-in bytes, not a document generated by the implementation under test. Only the current format is read, so when `FORMAT_VERSION` changes, re-run the generator and check that the content is unchanged.
